floater.name: ks_camera_positions
floater.title: Camera Positioning

check_box.label: Show disconnected
check_box.name: ks_camera_show_disconnected
check_box.tool_tip: Lists the views of sims the viewer is not connected to (dimmed: they can be applied and deleted). Off lists only this sim's and connected sims' views.

button.label: Apply
button.name: ks_camera_apply
button.tool_tip: Moves the camera to the selected view. A view of a sim that is not connected goes by where that sim was when last connected; the sim appears once the simulator connects it (it connects the sims near the camera).

button.label: Save current as...
button.name: ks_camera_save
button.tool_tip: Saves the current camera view under a name, for the sim the camera is over.

button.label: Update
button.name: ks_camera_update
button.tool_tip: Replaces the selected view with the current camera view; it moves to the sim the camera is over.

button.label: Delete...
button.name: ks_camera_delete
button.tool_tip: Deletes the selected view, of this sim or another.

button.label: Lock Camera
button.name: ks_camera_lock
button.tool_tip: Freezes the camera and your avatar: camera and movement controls do nothing. Press Esc three times to unlock and return to your avatar.

slider.label: Draw Distance
slider.name: ks_camera_draw_distance
slider.tool_tip: Draw distance in meters (RenderFarClip), 8 to 1024. Follows every other setter: Preferences, looks such as the Reference look, the /dd chat command.

check_box.label: Disable Camera Constraints
check_box.name: ks_camera_constraints
check_box.tool_tip: Lets the camera go farther from your avatar than your draw distance and below the ground, and lifts the zoom limits, so Apply moves the camera exactly to the view, also across a sim boundary. On by default in KStorm. The same setting as Preferences > Move & View > View and Advanced > Disable Camera Constraints.

floater.text: Double-click a view to move the camera there. Esc three times, closing this floater or a teleport unlocks and returns to your avatar.
floater.string: [SIM] is connected: the viewer has it loaded (a neighbour within draw distance), so its views can be applied. Edit them from [SIM].
